title: RNA analysis of stem cells from human deciduous tooth-derived dental pulp cells
author: Inada, Saitoh, et al.
materials: HDDPC-SOX2( +), but not HDDPC-SOX2(-), expressed SOX

steps.title: Fix and permeabilize cells
steps.instruction: Fix HDDPCs with paraformaldehyde (PFA), then permeabilize them before antibody incubation.

steps.title: Immunostain for OCT3/4 or SOX2
steps.instruction: Incubate permeabilized cells with anti‑OCT3/4 or anti‑SOX2 primary antibodies, followed by a peroxidase‑conjugated secondary antibody.

steps.title: Visualize with HistoGreen and pick cells
steps.instruction: Develop the peroxidase reaction by incubating cells in a solution containing HistoGreen; collect ~10 positively stained and ~10 negatively stained cells. For OCT3/4 staining, separate weakly positive cells (2–3 min reaction time) as HDDPC‑OCT3/4(+)L and their negatives as HDDPC‑OCT3/4(‑)L, and strongly positive cells (≤1 min reaction time) as HDDPC‑OCT3/4(+)S and their negatives as HDDPC‑OCT3/4(‑)S. For SOX2 staining, define positive cells as HDDPC‑SOX2(+) and negatives as HDDPC‑SOX2(‑).

steps.title: Purify mRNA and synthesize cDNA
steps.instruction: Subject the collected cells to mRNA purification, then perform cDNA synthesis using the purified mRNA.

steps.title: Whole transcriptome amplification (WTA)
steps.instruction: Amplify the cDNA using a Whole Transcriptome Amplification (WTA) kit.

steps.title: First‑round RT‑PCR
steps.instruction: Add 2 µL undiluted cDNA to a 20 µL PCR mix containing AmpliTaq Gold® 360 Master Mix (Applied Biosystems, #4,398,881) and the first‑PCR primer sets (see Table 1). Include a positive control (cDNA from ~0.5 µg HDDPC RNA) and a no‑template control (‑RT). Run 35 cycles: 95 °C 30 s, 52 °C 30 s, 72 °C 30 s on a Gene Atlas thermal cycler.

steps.title: Nested PCR
steps.instruction: Take 1 µL of the first‑PCR product and add to a new 20 µL reaction with AmpliTaq Gold® 360 Master Mix and the nested‑PCR primer sets (Table 1). Run the same cycling conditions (35 cycles, 95 °C 30 s, 52 °C 30 s, 72 °C 30 s).

steps.title: Agarose gel electrophoresis
steps.instruction: Load 3 µL of the nested‑PCR product onto a 2 % agarose gel, run electrophoresis, and stain the gel with ethidium bromide for visualization.

steps.title: Quantify bands with ImageJ
steps.instruction: Capture images of the gel, determine band intensities using ImageJ software, normalize each transcript’s intensity to GAPDH, and plot the densitometric data.
